summary: Queue VM power behind pending work on Core instead of reopening a busy-error dialog. API impact: changed contract; power prerequisite, queue capability, FIFO delivery and passive outcome adoption.

guide.reason: Describe queued acceptance, predecessor failure, recovery, older Core and ACPI limits.

api.reason: Document optional VMPowerRequest.after_operation_id, vm-power-queue-v1, host FIFO/persistence, queued/terminal outcomes and passive adoption without redispatch.

roadmap.reason: Corrects pending power behavior without changing milestone scope or acceptance status.

state.reason: Core owns received work, execution order, prerequisites and outcome; Controller only delivers and mirrors.
state.record: Pool master Core agent state.json Journal stores full commands, Order and local AfterOperationID; managed-vms journal stores execution prerequisites/results. Inventory.managed.outcomes recovers queued and terminal tasks in a fresh Controller as passive adopted operations, never redispatched.

verification.method: Go suite, UI checks/build, API reference/contract checks and simulated browser queue flow passed. Independent review findings fixed with focused regression checks; native queued guest execution not claimed.
